crossRefs.note: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.
They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover…
I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the…

translations.web: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
translations.bsb: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”
translations.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
translations.asv: For these things came to pass, that the scripture might be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
